title: Court of Federal Claims bid-protest volume, FY2024
description: Annual bid-protest filing/disposition volume from the CoFC's own FY2024 statistical report, recorded as node attrs on the `cofc` pack's protest-filing node for reference by custom expressions (e.g. a caseload-context metric). This is a raw annual count, not a rate: the report does not break down protest outcomes (sustained vs. denied), so `bid-protest-merits-ruling`'s out-edges remain unauthored — a good first candidate for the next calibration pass (see the `calibration` op's gap report).

source.title: Court of Federal Claims Statistical Report for the Fiscal Year October 1, 2023 - September 30, 2024

entries.method: Page 1: 'Under its non-monetary jurisdiction (bid protest jurisdiction), there were 266 cases filed and the court disposed of 188.' `n` is the count itself (a full-population annual total, not a sample).
